provenance.what: Four generation specs adding a SEED AXIS to the v2 comparison: seeds 1 and 2, both arms, against the seed-0 pair already staged.
provenance.why: Every published v2 figure is one realization of the decode. seed was 0 in all six committed code-style run documents and had never been varied, so the project had no noise floor and the guards +18 result could not be separated from decode variance. Board task 9d34f1bb (power audit) and opus-qa-cluster-0909's registration broadcast both name this class; this closes it for code-style with measurement rather than with a caveat.
provenance.differs: Each new spec differs from its OWN arm's seed-0 spec in exactly two keys, seed and label, verified before staging. Within each seed the two arms still differ in exactly arm and label, so the pairing that makes the comparison valid is unchanged.
provenance.reads: Same adapter (code-style-qlora-qwen-v2) and same holdout (code-corpus-v2.holdout.jsonl, sha256 5c1697e2fe06...) as the seed-0 pair, referenced BY PATH from inside these specs. That path is invisible to the command-line input check, as the seed-0 manifest also records.
provenance.expected: Three realizations of the v2 comparison. The spread of net guards/ruff/mypy and of the mid-p across seeds IS the noise floor this project has never had.
